presentation.label: MIST
presentation.overview: Target: original 32 kHz reverb and separate stereo diffuser in an independent FX2 insert. Only reference and storage primitives have been tested.
highlights: Original licensed Clouds source pinned by commit and file hash.
Compact storage keeps original delay lengths and quantization.
usage: Not installable yet; use the host reference scripts described in TESTING.md.

controls.name: TIME
controls.doc: Reverb decay; feedback remains below unity. Target control; not implemented.

controls.name: DAMP
controls.doc: Darkens the recirculating tail. Target control; not implemented.

controls.name: DIFF
controls.doc: Tank all-pass diffusion; about 70 percent by default. Target control; not qualified.

controls.name: SMEAR
controls.doc: Separate stereo input diffuser wet/dry amount. Target control; not implemented.

controls.name: GAIN
controls.doc: Tank input gain, planned -40 to 0 dB range; about -14 dB by default. Target control; not implemented.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Dry/wet blend; exact dry at 0 and fully wet at 127. Target control; not implemented.

limitations: Standalone 32 kHz core only: no integrated 44.1 kHz effect or installable firmware exists.
FX1 is outside the initial scope because its 3072-word allocation is too small.
Card/USB combinations, hardware and persistence have not been qualified.

storage.label: Storage
storage.conditions: Standalone experiments are measured in TESTING.md; complete installed-effect resource use has not been qualified.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.conditions: Standalone experiments are measured in TESTING.md; complete installed-effect resource use has not been qualified.

tests.summary: Native mixed-storage core preserves audio in three before/after cases, with clean guards and exact dry bypass on both cores. Host integer SRC and an offline 44.1 kHz stereo path are tested. Native SRC, full audio integration and hardware qualification remain unfinished.
gates: Worst-case cycles under parameter modulation and maximum load
Exact memory region and maximum-instance totals
Owner-reviewed real-hardware evidence with actual coverage and limitations

access.location: Target: audio track FX2 SETUP; unavailable until implementation.
steps: Hold FUNC and press FX2; choose Mist Verb with LEVEL and press YES (target UI, not verified).
Press FX2; adjust A TIME, B DAMP, C DIFF, D SMEAR, E GAIN and F MIX (target UI).

build.reason: Unpublished draft: optimized standalone 32 kHz native core plus a host SRC reference. Native 44.1 kHz conversion/mixing, complete performance and placement, composition, USB lifecycle and persistence remain unverified.
